items.description: Clothing and jewellery stolen from the car
items.rationale: Theft is excluded under §§2.1 and 3.1.4. Clothing and jewellery are also excluded personal property under §4.3(d), and §4.3(f) independently excludes property in a vehicle or away from the insured location.
The private car is not insured property under §4.3(e), and §5.2.5 excludes vehicle and journey costs. No insured debris transport or other covered work is involved.
